text:
4 pools, $6k in meteora rewards.

i’d watch fee/TVL while the tickets roll in. if rewards pull in LPs faster than trading grows, each dollar of liquidity could earn less in fees.

anyone tracking whether volume is keeping up with TVL?
note: Quote Meteora’s Nov 1 announcement of $6,000 in rewards across four eligible pools. The fee/TVL point is conditional, not a claim about these pools’ actual returns. Source was captured in out/trends.json on Nov 3; live twitterapi.io refresh failed due to DNS.
